title: Herb Crusted Canadian Salmon Skillet
description: A citrusy and flavorful solo dinner dish featuring Canadian salmon, herbs, and a beurre-monte sauce, perfect for a low-fat friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together parsley, dill, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Place the salmon fillet in a skillet and brush with olive oil.
Sprinkle the herb mixture evenly over the salmon fillet.
Squeeze lemon juice over the salmon and sprinkle with lemon zest.
Place the skillet in the oven and bake for 12 minutes.
While the salmon is baking, prepare the beurre-monte sauce by whisking it in a small saucepan over low heat.
Remove the skillet from the oven and brush the beurre-monte sauce over the salmon.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it rest for 1 minute before serving.
